rule: Allegiance rank ladder: 10 rungs per culture and gender, read from culture x gender switch. Shared book pages: each page carries author id, name and account plus an ignore-author bit; edit and delete allowed for the author, for ignore-author pages, or for admin. Allegiance XP pass-up: generated = (base + scale * loyalty/cap * (1 + time terms)) and received = (base + scale * leadership/cap * (1 + V * avg time terms)), passup = generated * received, with V = min(0.25 * vassals, 1). Time terms are pinned at cap in code (defect). Kill task: running counter, minimum delay between completions, max solves (-1 unlimited; message defect). Three societies: one per character, each with its own chat channel.
keep: Ten-rung rank ladder per culture with a male and female form.
Author stamp on every shared page, with an ignore-author flag for community pages.
Two-factor pass-up of a vassal's XP (generated and received), so the lord's share depends on both sides.
Kill task as a running chat counter with a minimum delay between completions.
Three societies as one faction field per character, each with a chat channel.
Unique point-of-interest names that a player can type to travel.
change: Measure the actual sworn time for the time terms instead of pinning them at cap.
Use double, not float, for XP products.
Fix the message for unlimited kill tasks and the success flag on modify-page replies.
Route every shared-page write through the server with a moderation filter.
Replace the donor's rank words, page text and society names with originals.
look_test: Build one zone with a notice board of three pages (one named author, one anyone-may-edit, one empty) with the author stamp under each. Add a kill task card with the counter line and a nameplate that shows one of ten rank words for a chosen culture. Judge on 375 wide whether the stamp reads as a town record and whether the ladder reads at a glance.
